scientific.integrity: The first Adam-GC step is reconstructed exactly from the defining algorithm with zero initial moments. A concavity argument proves the sharp dimension-only mean-drift supremum, and the official final-delta centralization is checked as an exact repair of the affine mean invariant.
limitations: Sharp envelope is for the first Adam-GC step with zero moments, positive epsilon, and no weight decay.
Later moment histories can produce different drift laws.
The result is worst-case over centered gradients and does not claim typical near-maximal drift.
The official GC2 repair itself is prior implementation knowledge; the new claim is the exact drift formula and sharp envelope.

title: Adam-GC has a sharp dimension-dependent mean-drift envelope
